description: This PHP class, ProjectActivityDetailedReportData, implements report data generation for project activity details within the OrangeHRM Time module. classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for generating detailed report data for project activities, including normalization of employee data and report metadata retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the report data object with filtering parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates a normalized array of project activity report data, including employee details and total durations.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the report, including total counts, total duration formatted into hours and minutes, and normalized project activity info.
